Accuracy Remediation: Cross-check Regulatory Reporting Flag with trusted source system (CRM, billing, KYC); auto-correct if match found; else flag for manual validation.
Consistency Remediation: Perform reconciliation with other systems; if mismatch, mark Policy as 'Pending Review' until corrected.
Deduplication Remediation: Check for duplicates; if found, merge or retain master record based on survivorship rules.
Timeliness Remediation: If Regulatory Reporting Flag is delayed, trigger SLA breach alert; attempt to fetch from latest transaction log; else notify steward.
Integrity Remediation: Validate referential integrity; if missing parent (e.g., Policy, Customer), queue record for correction before load.
Reasonableness Remediation: Check business ranges; if out-of-range, set to default threshold or flag as error for underwriter review.
